content.short: Pimlico Paymaster offers two types of paymasters, Verifying and ERC-20, to abstract gas fees for users.
content.description: Pimlico Paymaster offers two paymaster types - Verifying and ERC-20 - to abstract gas costs for users. The Verifying Paymaster lets developers load an off-chain Pimlico balance via their dashboard and sponsor on-chain gas fees for users across more than 30 chains. The ERC-20 Paymaster is a permissionless on-chain smart contract that enables users to pay gas fees themselves with their ERC-20 tokens. Together, these options simplify onboarding, expand funding models, and reduce upfront costs for users on compatible networks.
